Requirement for the endorsement of chang.one: Checklist when the foreign source of import changes name because it was sold (disinvestment).

pts: Standard file items, copy of the certificate, affidavit on earlier endorsements
Formal request letter from the dis-investor, with disinvestment proof
Buyer's undertaking: same quality, specification and manufacturing process
ATR from the buyer: purity and impurity profile of batch samples
Consent letter to supply the product to India

Requirement for the change of name of so.one: Checklist when the approved foreign source of import changes its name or manufacturing premises.

pts: Standard file items, copy of the certificate, affidavit on earlier endorsements
Proof of the name or premises change, authenticated by the Indian Embassy / Consulate
Reason: merger, takeover, internal re-arrangement or shifting
ATRs from old and newly named source, with quality and process undertaking
Supporting document from the Designated National Authority
Consent letter legalised by the Indian Embassy in the source country

Requirement for the endorsement for incl.one: Checklist to add, on your certificate, an additional source of import that the RC has already approved.

pts: Standard file items and affidavit on earlier endorsements
Consent letter legalised by the Indian Embassy in the source country
RC meeting reference that approved the additional source
Copy of the certificate with label / leaflet

Requirement for the endorsement of enhan.one: Checklist for a 9(4) registrant to get the longer shelf life already approved for the 9(3) registrant (see 1.7).

pts: Standard file items; notarized BOD resolution and manufacturing licence
Affidavit on earlier endorsements
Shelf-life enhancement proforma (from 1.7)
Name of the 9(3) registrant and the CIB meeting that approved its enhancement

Requirement For Free Sale Certificate.one: Checklist to get a Free Sale Certificate (FSC), usually asked by importing countries (315th RC, 2011).

pts: Standard file items and notarized authorisation of the signatory
Notarized certificate(s) with all endorsements: transfer, name change, address change
Notarized valid manufacturing licence
Justification for needing the FSC

watch: Regular registrants may apply separately for export only, or for use in India plus export

Requirement for the endorsement of chang.one: Checklist to change the registered office address on certificates.

pts: Standard file items and affidavit on earlier endorsements
Copies of the certificates with labels / leaflets
Company: notarized Registrar of Companies proof of the new address
Proprietor / firm: notarized affidavit with old address and reason for change
Affidavit of no court case, with product list

Requirement for the submission of applic.one: Checklist to get copies of your certificates attested by CIB&RC, usually for an importing country.

pts: Standard file items and notarized BOD resolution
Notarized certificate copies with labels / leaflets, in duplicate, indexed
Affidavit in the 314th RC format: copies used only for export of these products

watch: Original certificates must be shown to the designated officer for verification

Requirement for the endorsement of name.one: Checklist to add the name of a supplier for a source of import that is already approved.

pts: Standard file items and affidavit on earlier endorsements
Consent letter from the approved source, legalised by the Indian Embassy
RC meeting reference and copy of the certificate with label / leaflet

Requirement for the submission of applic.one: Checklist for an RTT (research, test and trial) import application (320th and 329th RC).

pts: Standard file items, notarized BOD resolution, signed Form C
Justification for quantity; technical bulletin; chemistry, toxicity, bio-efficacy information
Registration certificate from the source country; supplier authorisation if not the manufacturer
Microbials: notarized GMO-free affidavit + manufacturer's document
Coded / unregistered pesticides: document from the inventor

Requirement for the issue of duplicate r.one: Checklist for a duplicate certificate when the original is lost (320th RC, 2011).
nums: wait after the newspaper advertisement before applying

pts: Standard file items, fee, affidavit on earlier endorsements with certificate details
Copy of the FIR for the lost certificate
Cutting of the newspaper advertisement about the loss
Copy of the letter informing the State Licensing Authority
Notarized photocopy of the lost certificate and labels, if available

watch: Affidavit: if the original is found, it must be returned at once and not misused

Requirement for extension of shelf life.one: Checklist to extend shelf life using continued storage-stability data (9(3B) / 9(3)).

pts: Standard file items, notarized BOD resolution, certificate with labels
Copy of the Form-I submitted originally
New shelf-life claim, with shelf-life data and meteorological data

watch: One data location must be CIL Faridabad: as one of two locations for biopesticides, as an additional location for chemicals (333rd RC)

Requirement for the endorsement of exten.one: Checklist to revalidate or extend validity of 9(4) certificates, plus the 9(3) list from the 442nd RC.

pts: Standard file items, BOD resolution, industry category certificate, licence for other pesticides
Certificates with labels; affidavit on earlier endorsements
Notarized justification, with evidence, for not taking a manufacturing licence
Pollution Control Board NOC, if taken
Covering letter, endorsement affidavit, source / ICAMA certificate with original, legalised consent, PCB NOC

watch: Not applicable to 9(4) formulation certificates (333rd RC)

Requirements for the change of name of a.one: Checklist when the approved foreign source changes only its office name / address.

pts: Standard file items, certificate copy, affidavit, embassy-authenticated proof of the change
Reason for the change; ATR from the newly named source with undertaking
DNA document and embassy-legalised consent letter

Requirements for the change of address o.one: Checklist when the foreign manufacturer closes the old unit and moves production to a new address.
nums: analysis report from the changed source

pts: Standard file items, certificate copy, affidavit, embassy-authenticated proof of the new address
Reason for the change; 5-batch analysis with quality and process undertaking
DNA document and embassy-legalised consent letter

Requirements for the change of name of s.one: Combined checklist for a change of the source's name or of its manufacturing premises abroad.

pts: Standard file items, certificate with label, affidavit, embassy-authenticated proof of the change
Reason: merger, takeover, re-arrangement or shifting
ATR from the new premises with undertaking; DNA document; legalised consent letter

No-MRL agricultural chemicals list (FSSA.one: FSSAI list of agricultural chemicals for which no Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) applies, each with its condition of use (464th RC).

pts: Each entry applies only under its stated condition (e.g. chlorine dioxide ≤ 10 ppm on fruit and vegetables)
Examples: chitosan, hydrogen peroxide, geraniol on grapevines, gibberellic acid < 200 g a.i./ha/year
RC also seeks MRL relaxation for seed-treatment products, spray oils and nursery-stage pesticides
